design.fold_definition: six consecutive non-overlapping sixths of each symbol's 60m series; no fold shares a bar with another
design.exit: ATRx1 stop, ANCHOR_ATR targets 1.0/2.5, scale 50/50, BE 1.5R, 40-bar time stop, exit_at_session_close=False
design.filters: rth_only=False (deliberate: RTH would delete London and Asia)
design.costs: engine default - 0.5 tick base slippage, +1.0 tick thin book (non-RTH fills), +1.0 tick for stop orders, commission per side from ContractSpec; entries fill at the NEXT bar's open
